def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] = values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.
    Returns the mode value, then the level value, then the values of any
    other keys in the order each key first appears. A repeated key keeps its
    last value."""
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
    ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
    ex settings(["a", "b", "a"], ["1", "2", "3"]) == ["fast", "3", "3", "2"]
    mode = "fast"
    level = "3"
    others: dict[str, str] = {}
    order: list[str] = []
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        v = values[i]
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v.copy()
        elif k == "level":
            level = v.copy()
        else:
            if k in others:
                others[k.copy()] = v.copy()
            else:
                order.append(k.copy())
                others[k.copy()] = v.copy()
    result: list[str] = [mode, level]
    for k in order:
        result.append(others.get(k) else "")
    return result
